parameters{
	vCM_EnrollSource as string (),
	VMax_BATCH_NUM as timestamp (),
	vMemberNewCaseCount as integer (),
	vMemberNewCaseEmailMessage as string (),
	vMemberNewCaseEmailRecipients as string (),
	vMemberNewCaseExportFile as string (),
	vMemberNewCaseExportFileName as string (),
	vMemberNewCaseExportFolder as string (),
	vMemberNoMatchCount as integer (),
	vMemberNoMatchEmailMessage as string (),
	vMemberNoMatchEmailRecipients as string (),
	vMemberNoMatchExportFile as string (),
	vMemberNoMatchExportFileName as string (),
	vMemberNoMatchExportFolder as string (),

source(output(
		OLD_CASE_CREATION_DATE as integer,
		NEW_CASE_ID as string,
		NEW_CASE_CREATION_DATE as integer,
		OLD_CASE_ID as string,
		MEMBER_SBSB_ID as string,
		MEMBER_MEME_CK as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT MEMBER_SBSB_ID,MEMBER_MEME_CK,OLD_CASE_ID,OLD_CASE_CREATION_DATE,NEW_CASE_ID,NEW_CASE_CREATION_DATE FROM ( 	SELECT H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_SBSB_ID AS MEMBER_SBSB_ID,H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_MEME_CK AS MEMBER_MEME_CK,H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_ID AS OLD_CASE_ID,H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CREATE_DATE AS OLD_CASE_CREATION_DATE,S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CASE_ID AS NEW_CASE_ID,S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CREATE_DATE AS NEW_CASE_CREATION_DATE,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_SBSB_ID ORDER BY S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CREATE_DATE DESC,S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CASE_ID DESC) AS ROWNUM 	FROM ( 		SELECT MAX(CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID) AS MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID  		FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID = CL.CALLLIST_IID AND CL.CALLLIST_CD = \'137\' 	) MAXCD 		INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON MAXCD.MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID 		INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = M.MEMBER_IID 		INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_137_HISTORY H ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID = H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_IID 		INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_137_STAGING S ON M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER = S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_SBSB_ID + \'00\' 			AND H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_ID <> S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CASE_ID 			AND H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CREATE_DATE < S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CREATE_DATE ) NEWCASES WHERE ROWNUM = 1',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> MembersWithNewCasesFromPDSStagingTable
MembersWithNewCasesFromPDSStagingTable sink(input(
		OLD_CASE_CREATION_DATE as string,
		NEW_CASE_ID as string,
		NEW_CASE_CREATION_DATE as string,
		OLD_CASE_ID as string,
		MEMBER_SBSB_ID as string,
		MEMBER_MEME_CK as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		OLD_CASE_CREATION_DATE,
		NEW_CASE_ID,
		NEW_CASE_CREATION_DATE,
		OLD_CASE_ID,
		MEMBER_SBSB_ID,
		MEMBER_MEME_CK)) ~> MemberNewCaseErrorFile
